about_the_game:
Supercat Survivors: Meow or Die is a cute cat-style Survivor-like game—call your girlfriend to play and save Meow Star from crisis! You'll control a Supercat battling through 20 waves of enemies. Upgrade and purchase weapons and items to empower your Supercat, preparing for the ultimate challenge of the unrelenting Endless Mode!

Cute Style – Purrfect for Sharing with Your Girlfriend

Who can resist sharing this adorable cat-themed game with their girlfriend? Tired of bloody battles and dark dungeons? Here lies a sanctuary of pure feline charm, waiting for you and your loved one to enjoy together, experience cozy cat moments, and lead your Supercats to defeat monsters and save Meow Star!

Story – Crisis on Meow Star

On the spirit-energy-rich Meow Star, Supercat warriors guard the planet’s lifeblood—the Gemstone Ore—while battling mutated plants for survival. These plants corrupt the land with invasive roots and devour energy with parasitic spores. The cats fight back with spirit-powered weapons, living tense yet peaceful lives.

Suddenly, chaos erupts! Alien beasts invade Meow Star, mutated plants go berserk, and the Supercats are caught in a pincer attack. A sinister alliance between the invaders and local mutants hides a secret buried deep in ancient ruins…

Unravel the conspiracy—Meow is Justice! The fate of Meow Star hinges on one final battle!

Survivor-like – Pure Combat Thrills

Meow~ Each battle features 20 waves of enemies, lasting about a minute per wave. Control Supercats' movement—their weapons auto-attack, transforming cute fluffballs into ruthless killers. Between waves, upgrade gear and push their power to the limit!

Roguelike – Deep Build Synergy

Meow~ 20+ unique Supercats, 160+ items, and 20+ weapons offer endless Roguelike combinations. Each Supercat has strengths and weaknesses—mastering synergies and growth paths is key! Experiment with strategies for surprising results!

Multiple Difficulties – Endless Challenges

Meow~ As your Supercats grow stronger, so do the enemies. Clear 20 waves to unlock higher difficulties—true Supercats never surrender! Once you’ve mastered the rhythm, brace yourself for Endless Mode—a limitless trial of skill and grit!

Lick your paws, unsheathe your claws, and face the infinite!
